prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for the matchBlade mobile puzzle game.
Input image 1 (atlas-v062.png) is the EDIT TARGET. Input image 2 (stone-v065.png) is a supporting reference: it shows the exact CURRENT in-game stone tile, which uses warm neutral gray instead of the blue stone panel in the old atlas.

Edit ONLY the colored inner background panels of the eight occupied tiles. Give every panel a clearly visible but restrained top-left-to-bottom-right gradient with a broad softly lit upper corner, richer midtone, and a deeper lower corner. Add one or two subtle broad beveled geometric facets/diagonal enamel bands in each background, with low contrast so they feel designed and polished without competing with the icon. Keep saturated identifiable tile colors and modern glossy HD pixel-art finish. No additional sparkle, stars, particle dots, bloom, tiny busy texture or ornaments. No opaque glare over icons.

Background colors:
crossed swords: crimson/ruby red gradient.
purple fireball: amethyst to deep violet gradient.
shield: cobalt to dark navy blue gradient.
key: rich emerald green gradient.
diamond: luminous gold to muted brass gradient, not orange.
WOOD LOGS: completely REMOVE the orange background and orange inner rim. Replace with muted earthy olive-brown: sage-olive highlights (#737554), olive-brown midtones (#4d5140), deep charcoal olive lower corner (#242d25). This background must be visibly different from the bright emerald key tile. Keep the log icon itself exactly warm brown/orange as it currently is.
STONE: use the current stone tile in input image 2 as the reference for its unchanged rock symbol and warm neutral gray background. Give its warm gray panel a subtle pewter-to-charcoal gradient/facet design. Do NOT use a blue background, which would duplicate shield.
potion: turquoise/teal gradient, with a subtle pearly finish. Preserve the green liquid bottle.

CRITICAL INVARIANTS: preserve the 3x3 atlas layout, tile order, source canvas proportions, individual tile positions and sizes, thin dark metal frames and clipped/chamfered corners, transparent outside/gutters. Preserve foreground symbol silhouettes, poses, colors and details from the existing game: crossed swords, fireball, shield, key, diamond, logs, rocks and potion. No new icons. Ninth empty gray tile stays unchanged. No labels, letters, text, watermark, extra tiles or large shadows outside frames. True alpha transparency outside each tile. This is a background-panel polish pass, not a redesign of the icons.
